description: This is a Python source file implementing functions for extracting and summarizing text and data from various file formats (.txt, .pdf, .docx, .xlsx, .json). It includes detailed heuristics for processing Excel files into JSON arrays, extracting text from PDFs and Word documents, and summarizing JSON data structures.
